avis.texte: While I did not purchase this item from Ulta (mine came direct from Dr. Melaxin) I knew a review here would be helpful. Yes, this particular formula contains parfum (strongest concentrated scent that can be added to products). It has a heavy rose scent and can be a turn off or irritant for those with sensitive skin or strong allergies, so buyer beware. Most of their products do NOT contain strong scents like this one does. I find that it's a good cleanser for just daily grime and removing sunblock. However on days that I have heavy makeup application, this just does not cut it for me. So I have to switch to an oil then creme two step cleanse process on those days. Also, if you already have drier skin, avoid this one. Foaming cleansers tend to have drying affects on the skin and I definitely noticed after using this for about 5 days. I imagine this product is great for most folks but for my personal needs (sensitive combination skin w/allergies to most things) this one is an item I won't be re-buying in the future for myself. (Yes I still love other products from Dr. Melaxin.)
